subhead: For the final stop of his African tour, the French president chose Ethiopia. The visit gave him another opportunity to publicly support Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, whose actions in the Tigray region – which was the scene of a deadly war between 2020 and 2022 – have drawn criticism.

headline: At the Cannes Film Festival, the art of criticizing without offending: 'It might be your most personal film yet'
subhead: With festival up and running, columnist Guillemette Faure explores the art of expressing an opinion without really stating it, so as not to upset anyone after a screening.

headline: What do Christians celebrate on Ascension Day?
subhead: On May 14, Christians celebrate the Ascension, symbolizing Jesus' ascent to God. Le Monde explores the history and symbolism of one of Christianity's most important feasts.

headline: With CMA Média, shipping magnate Rodolphe Saadé expands his empire
subhead: 'The shipping giant at the heart of French power' (4/4). Since 2022, CMA Média, the subsidiary of shipping giant CMA CGM, has multiplied its media acquisitions from La Provence to La Tribune Dimanche, as well as BFM-TV and RMC, and is looking to strengthen its sports division. Journalists have expressed their opposition to consolidation plans and editorial interference.

subhead: The sociologist Stéphane Beaud explored in an essay the football player's career, framing it within that of the descendants of Algerian immigrants. In an interview, he explains that the athlete tried to make up for the injustices suffered by his father, who remained at the bottom of the social ladder throughout his life.

headline: French far-right mayors' first steps target Europe, culture and unions
subhead: Le Monde examined the first decisions made by newly-elected far-right mayors. While they have not yet kept their tax promises, almost all of them have increased their own allowances, hired police officers and targeted local figures who are politically hostile to them.

headline: Wine consumption continues to decline around the world
subhead: Wine consumption fell by 2.7% year-on-year, according to data released on Tuesday by the International Organization of Vine and Wine. But France remains the world's leading wine exporter by value.
